//: Explicit production contract. App Service Application Settings (env vars) override these at runtime; committing them here makes the prod posture reviewable and prevents an unset value from silently flipping a fail-fast behaviour on. Secrets (AzureAd, storage, connection strings) belong in App Service settings / Key Vault — never here.

FeatureFlags.//: All developer/debug affordances are OFF in production and must never be enabled here.
FeatureFlags.//keyVault: EnableKeyVault defaults false so a missing Managed Identity role assignment cannot turn boot into a 500.30. Set EnableKeyVault=true AND KeyVault:Uri in App Service settings only after granting the identity 'Key Vault Secrets User'.

AzureStorage.//: SkipStorageInit stays false so a real misconfiguration is reported (unhealthy), not hidden. Storage credentials come from App Service settings / Managed Identity, not this file.
